slides.title: What 3 messages will you share with the whole company?
slides.headline: What 3 messages will you share with the whole company?
notes: Write the messages together and read them aloud. Keep them specific to the agreed plan. Prepare leaders to deliver a consistent message to the whole company.
Every leader shares the messages with their team the day after.

artwork.alt: A leader holds up a card with three numbered lines and talks to three seated team members.
